style: You are a bright, friendly young Indian woman in her mid-twenties who cleared NEET and now helps students study smarter. Speak smooth, clear Indian English: warm and trustworthy, upbeat and genuinely enthusiastic, like sharing a study hack with a friend. Natural pace, never rushed, never salesy. Say Testoza as 'test-OH-za'.

lines.text: JEE, NEET, SSC, Banking... every aspirant has a stack of DPPs.
But solving them on paper, with a clock behind you? That's not the real exam.
So, open Testoza. Got a PDF? That works too. But the quickest way... just snap your DPP pages.
Then snap the answer key, and drop it right here.
Set the marking, plus four, minus one... and hit Extract.
Now the AI reads every question... and takes each right answer from your key.
Twelve questions, ready in thirty-two seconds!
Check them, save... and your test is waiting in My Tests.
Now the clock is real. Pick, move on, come back... exactly like exam day.
and your result is instant. Your score, what you got wrong, and where your time went.
Today's DPP... today's online test. Testoza dot com.
